title: Nice product
text: Nice product. I am a coffee lover! This sign looks cute in my kitchen. It is very light so it wont tear up the plaster when you hang it. It is a nice size, easy to hang and fits any decor. Now Im thinking of hanging it under the top cabinets right where my coffee pot is, as a personalized coffee station lol. Nice sign!
